ubuntu.name: Ubuntu 24.04
ubuntu.install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 liblzma5 libgcc-s1 libxkbcommon0 libxkbcommon-x11-0 libx11-6 libxcursor1 libxi6 libxrandr2 libxrender1 libxext6 xvfb x11-utils weston dbus-daemon && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

debian.name: Debian 13
debian.install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 liblzma5 libgcc-s1 libxkbcommon0 libxkbcommon-x11-0 libx11-6 libxcursor1 libxi6 libxrandr2 libxrender1 libxext6 xvfb x11-utils weston dbus-daemon && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

fedora.name: Fedora 44
fedora.install: dnf install -y python3 xz-libs libgcc libxkbcommon libxkbcommon-x11 libX11 libXcursor libXi libXrandr libXrender libXext xorg-x11-server-Xvfb xwininfo weston dbus-daemon && dnf clean all

opensuse.name: openSUSE Tumbleweed
opensuse.install: zypper --non-interactive install --no-recommends python3 liblzma5 libgcc_s1 libxkbcommon0 libxkbcommon-x11-0 libX11-6 libXcursor1 libXi6 libXrandr2 libXrender1 libXext6 xorg-x11-server-Xvfb xwininfo weston dbus-1 && zypper clean --all
